crossRefs.note: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will…
God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings…
The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying…
Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
kings of the earth and all peoples; princes and all judges of the earth;
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

translations.web: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
translations.bsb: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
translations.kjv: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
translations.asv: And a voice came forth from the throne, saying, Give praise to our God, all ye his servants, ye that fear him, the small and the great.
